CREATE UNIQUE INDEX local_products_sku ON local_products(sku) WHERE sku <> ''

CREATE TABLE local_billing_ledger (
 invoice_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_invoices(id), account TEXT NOT NULL
 CHECK(account IN ('cash','receivables','revenue','tax_payable')),
 customer_id TEXT, amount_paise INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_paise<>0),
 PRIMARY KEY(invoice_id,account)
)

CREATE TABLE local_billing_outbox (
 sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
 invoice_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES local_invoices(id), payload TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE local_checkout (
        singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),
        operation_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        request TEXT NOT NULL
    )
CREATE TABLE local_checkout_canceled (operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE local_inventory_events (
        operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
        product_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_products(id),
        kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('product_added','stock_adjusted')),
        request TEXT NOT NULL,
        result TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'))
    )

CREATE TABLE local_invoice_stock (
 invoice_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_invoices(id),
 product_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_products(id),
 quantity_milli INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(quantity_milli>0),
 before_milli INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(before_milli>=quantity_milli),
 after_milli INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(after_milli=before_milli-quantity_milli),
 PRIMARY KEY(invoice_id,product_id)
)

CREATE TABLE local_invoices (
 sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
 id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, request TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE local_products (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        sku TEXT NOT NULL,
        unit TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(unit IN ('pcs','kg','litre','metre')),
        unit_price_paise INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(unit_price_paise BETWEEN 0 AND 9000000000000),
        stock_milli INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(stock_milli BETWEEN 0 AND 9000000000000),
        revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision > 0)
    )

CREATE TABLE local_recovery_audit (
 seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, operation_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 action TEXT NOT NULL, backup_id TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE local_recovery_identity (
 singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton = 1), business_id TEXT NOT NULL, generation TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE workspace_access (
                    singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (singleton = 1),
                    password_hash TEXT,
                    failed_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (failed_attempts BETWEEN 0 AND 5),
                    retry_after INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (retry_after >= 0)
                )

CREATE TABLE workspace_draft (
                singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (singleton = 1),
                revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision > 0),
                payload TEXT NOT NULL
                )

CREATE TABLE workspace_history (
                    revision INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (revision > 0),
                    payload TEXT NOT NULL
                )
CREATE TRIGGER local_billing_audit_no_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON local_billing_audit BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Posted billing records are immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER local_billing_audit_no_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON local_billing_audit BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Posted billing records are immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER local_billing_ledger_no_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON local_billing_ledger BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Posted billing records are immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER local_billing_ledger_no_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON local_billing_ledger BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Posted billing records are immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER local_billing_outbox_no_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON local_billing_outbox BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Posted billing records are immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER local_billing_outbox_no_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON local_billing_outbox BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Posted billing records are immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER local_checkout_canceled_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON local_checkout_canceled
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Canceled checkout IDs cannot be reused'); END

CREATE TRIGGER local_checkout_canceled_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON local_checkout_canceled
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Canceled checkout IDs cannot be reused'); END

CREATE TRIGGER local_inventory_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON local_inventory_events
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Inventory history is append only'); END

CREATE TRIGGER local_inventory_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON local_inventory_events
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Inventory history is append only'); END
CREATE TRIGGER local_invoice_stock_no_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON local_invoice_stock BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Posted billing records are immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER local_invoice_stock_no_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON local_invoice_stock BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Posted billing records are immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER local_invoices_no_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON local_invoices BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Posted billing records are immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER local_invoices_no_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON local_invoices BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Posted billing records are immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER local_recovery_audit_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON local_recovery_audit
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'immutable recovery audit'); END

CREATE TRIGGER local_recovery_audit_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON local_recovery_audit
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'immutable recovery audit'); END
